note: Renders 'Mon-Tue: 9am-5pm, Tue: 6pm-9pm, Tue: 10pm-11:45pm, Wed: 9am-5pm'. Wed is orphaned from the Mon-Tue run. generateCompactText groups by list adjacency, not by time-key. lib/availability-format.ts:36

title: 'No more lessons to load' shows mid-panel after content has loaded
expected: An end-of-list state should read as an end-of-list state, not an error
note: REPORTED BY ANDRES. Upcoming Lessons -> View All opens a panel that renders 'no more lessons to load' in the middle of the panel even though content is already present. Reads as a failure when it is just the end of a paginated list, and the panel does not follow the Thoven design system. Cosmetic, but it is the second place this run where an empty/end state contradicts loaded content - the teacher Homework tab does the same thing, showing '1 assigned, 0 completed' next to 'No active homework yet' (A-15).

title: Teach Mode rendered no controls at all - could not verify, environment caveat
note: The live page contains 146 elements total, ZERO <button>, zero role=button, zero elements with cursor:pointer, zero <svg>, and no iframe. Not hidden - absent. Mouse-move did not reveal a hover toolbar. NOT REPORTING THIS AS A DEFECT: headless Chromium has no camera or mic, and the chrome plausibly mounts only after a media/readiness gate that this environment never satisfies. The backend control does exist and is routed - POST teachers/live_lessons/:booking_slot_id/end_lesson, live_lessons_controller.rb:45. Needs a re-run on a real machine with devices to settle. Flagging because a total absence of controls is worth ruling out rather than assuming.

title: Planned card charge did not occur - platform paid instead
expected: One real $4.00 purchase on the books
note: CORRECTED after teacher approval. Money DID move, just not the parents: Stripe transfer tr_1U2HviElCoK3ywsju5WhtAdH sent $4.00 to the teacher, thoven_absorbed_total_cents=400. The parent card was never charged (no PaymentIntent). So the CARD-CAPTURE path is unverified by this run; the platform-funded subsidy path IS verified and works.

title: NOT A BUG - calendar overlay intercepting card buttons
note: Recorded so it is not re-investigated. With the My Lessons Calendar panel open, elementFromPoint over Join Meeting / Reschedule / Cancel returns the calendar container, and Playwright clicks time out. That is correct behaviour - the calendar is a deliberate full overlay with its own Close button. With it closed all three buttons are reachable. Distinct from the AddPaymentMethodModal defect, where the blocked control is inside the modal itself.
